Warning: the driver is responsible for controlling the vehicle at all times. Use only in confirmed safe conditions. Repeated use may reduce braking performance. Use with care.
 
Requirements: 
1. Vehicle stopped, doors closed, driver and passenger buckled.
2. Powertrain temperature normal and battery sufficient.
3. Driver assist off, steering straight, parking brake released, in D.
 
How to use: 
1. Turn on Launch control.
2. Press the brake fully, then the accelerator fully. When the display shows launch ready, release the brake within 4 seconds to accelerate. (If launch fails, check the main screen and vehicle status)

Warning: the driver is responsible for controlling the vehicle and for safe conditions. Use only in safe conditions. Repeated long use may reduce drive and brake performance; use with care.

Requirements:
1. Vehicle stopped, doors closed, driver and passenger buckled.
2. Powertrain temperature normal and battery sufficient.
3. Driver assist off, steering straight, parking brake released, in D.

How to use:
1. Turn on Launch control.
2. Press the brake fully, then the accelerator. When the display shows “Launch ready”, release the brake within 4 seconds for maximum acceleration. (If “Launch failed” appears, check the main screen and vehicle status.)
3. Drive mode switches to Sport and stays Sport after the feature turns off.
4. One-touch drift turns off (if on).
5. In Track mode, item 3 does not change the drive mode.
